zh.principle: **标准**：传输层密码协议（TLCP）。TLCP 的密钥计算是 TLS 1.2 风格。先定义 \(P\_hash(secret,seed)=HMAC(secret,A_1\|seed)\|HMAC(secret,A_2\|seed)\|\cdots\)，其中 \(A_0=seed\)、\(A_i=HMAC(secret,A_{i-1})\)；再定义 \(PRF(secret,label,seed)=P\_hash(secret,label\|seed)\)。主密钥为 \(PRF(pre\_master,\text{“master secret”},client\_random\|server\_random)[0..47]\)，固定 48 字节。工作密钥由 \(PRF(master,\text{“key expansion”},server\_random\|client\_random)\) 生成 key_block，再按 client MAC、server MAC、client key、server key、client IV、server IV 的顺序切分。Finished 的 \(verify\_data\) 取 \(PRF(master,label,SM3(handshake\_messages))[0..11]\)，固定 12 字节。记录层 MAC 覆盖 \(seq\|type\|version\|length\|fragment\)，AEAD 的附加数据覆盖 \(seq\|type\|version\|length\)。
zh.why: TLCP 常被误当成“国密版 TLS 1.3”。实际标准版本字段是 0x0101，密钥计算是 TLS 1.2 的 PRF/P_hash，不是 HKDF；它用 SM2 做身份鉴别与密钥交换、SM3 做杂凑、SM4 做记录层加密。双证书是另一个关键差异：签名证书只做身份鉴别，加密证书只做密钥交换，二者不能合并成一张证书。把 PRF、key_block、Finished、记录 MAC 写成公式，才能把“国密 TLS”与“TLS 1.3”区分开。
zh.used: 读握手时先看版本 0x0101 和套件 ID，再按双证书验证签名证书、用加密证书解出预主密钥。双方各自用 \(client\_random\)、\(server\_random\) 和预主密钥算 48 字节主密钥，再算 key_block；切分顺序不能颠倒。记录层若走 CBC，MAC 覆盖序号到片段；若走 GCM，附加数据只覆盖序号、类型、版本、长度，密文本身由 AEAD 认证。Finished 用 SM3 的握手 transcript，验证 12 字节 \(verify\_data\)。
zh.broken: 边界有四条。第一，TLCP 是 TLS 1.2 风格，不支持 TLS 1.3 的 0-RTT、PSK、KeyUpdate，也不能把 HKDF 的 \(Extract/Expand\) 套进来。第二，CBC 套件要正确处理填充与 MAC-then-Encrypt 的顺序，否则会出现填充 oracle 类问题；GCM 套件要保证 nonce 唯一。第三，双证书要求签名私钥与加密私钥分离，若把两张证书混用或让同一密钥承担两种用途，会破坏标准的用途分离。第四，标准规定协议与密钥计算，不替代实现侧信道、证书生命周期和部署审计。
zh.history:
GB/T 38636—2020 于 2020-04-28 发布、2020-11-01 实施，规定记录层协议、握手协议族和密钥计算；它把 TLCP 定位为传输层密码协议，适用于 SSL VPN 网关、浏览器等产品。标准中的套件用 SM2/SM3/SM4，并保留 RSA/IBC 等密钥交换分支；这里只重述标准文本，不把厂商实现或 TLS 1.3 的特性写成标准要求。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：传输层密码协议的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 传输层密码协议 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

en.principle: **Standard**: TLCP (传输层密码协议). TLCP key calculation is TLS 1.2-style. First \(P\_hash(secret,seed)=HMAC(secret,A_1\|seed)\|HMAC(secret,A_2\|seed)\|\cdots\), with \(A_0=seed\) and \(A_i=HMAC(secret,A_{i-1})\); then \(PRF(secret,label,seed)=P\_hash(secret,label\|seed)\). The master secret is \(PRF(pre\_master,\text{“master secret”},client\_random\|server\_random)[0..47]\), exactly 48 bytes. The key block is \(PRF(master,\text{“key expansion”},server\_random\|client\_random)\), carved in client MAC, server MAC, client key, server key, client IV, server IV order. Finished takes \(verify\_data=PRF(master,label,SM3(handshake\_messages))[0..11]\), exactly 12 bytes. The record MAC covers \(seq\|type\|version\|length\|fragment\); AEAD additional data covers \(seq\|type\|version\|length\).
en.why: TLCP is often mistaken for a “Chinese TLS 1.3”. Its version field is 0x0101 and its key schedule is TLS 1.2 PRF/P_hash, not HKDF; it uses SM2 for authentication and key exchange, SM3 for hashing and SM4 for record encryption. Dual certificates are another key difference: the signature certificate is only for authentication and the encryption certificate only for key exchange; they cannot be merged. Writing PRF, key_block, Finished and record MAC as formulas is how “Chinese TLS” is separated from TLS 1.3.
en.used: When reading a handshake, check version 0x0101 and the suite ID, verify the signature certificate, then use the encryption certificate to recover the pre-master. Both sides compute the 48-byte master from \(client\_random\), \(server\_random\) and the pre-master, then the key_block; the carving order must not be reversed. For CBC records, the MAC covers sequence through fragment; for GCM, additional data covers only sequence, type, version and length, while the ciphertext is authenticated by AEAD. Finished hashes the handshake transcript with SM3 and verifies 12 bytes of \(verify\_data\).
en.broken: There are four boundaries. First, TLCP is TLS 1.2-style and does not support TLS 1.3 0-RTT, PSK or KeyUpdate; do not apply HKDF \(Extract/Expand\). Second, CBC suites must handle padding and MAC-then-Encrypt order correctly or fall into padding-oracle classes; GCM suites need unique nonces. Third, dual certificates require separate signature and encryption private keys; merging them or letting one key serve both uses breaks the standard separation. Fourth, the standard specifies protocol and key calculation, not implementation side channels, certificate lifecycle or deployment audits.
en.history: GB/T 38636—2020 was published on 2020-04-28 and took effect on 2020-11-01, specifying the record layer, handshake family and key calculation; it positions TLCP as a transport-layer cryptographic protocol for SSL VPN gateways, browsers and similar products. Its suites use SM2/SM3/SM4 and retain RSA/IBC key-exchange branches; this account restates the standard text, not vendor implementations or TLS 1.3 features.
